extracted.intended_audience: submitters/applicants (e.g., creative writers) looking for opportunities on Submittable
extracted.subtask_description: How to find and apply for opportunities (grants, contests, residencies, fellowships, etc.) using the Submittable Discover marketplace and platform account. Covers browsing listings, creating an account, and completing an organization's application form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Browse Discover marketplace
rubrics_metrics.description: Browse our open Discover marketplace for opportunities based on information like keywords, deadlines, and fees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search the free marketplace for thousands of opportunities, creative calls, grants, fellowships, scholarships, residencies, contests, and more. Use keywords, deadlines, and fee filters to find relevant listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create a free individual Submittable account
rubrics_metrics.description: When you find an opportunity you’re interested in, create a free individual Submittable account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sign up as an individual submitter (use the Sign Up/Sign In options). An account is required to apply and manage submissions through the platform.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply by filling out the organization's application form
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply for your opportunity by filling out the organization’s application form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the fields and attach any required materials per the organization's form instructions; submissions are collected and reviewed through Submittable.
